message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on a Monday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend).  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Observed (if applicable) | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|--------------------------|-------|
| **Good Friday** | April 7 | Friday | — | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun). |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | — | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon). |
| **Canada Day** | July 1 | Saturday | Observed July 3 (Monday) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon). |
| **Labour Day** | September 4 | Monday | — | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon). |
| **Thanksgiving** | October 9 | Monday | — | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon). |
| **Remembrance Day** | November 11 | Saturday | Observed November 13 (Monday) | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon). |
| **Christmas** | December 25 | Monday | — | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Mon). |

### Quick Reference (JSON)

```json
[
  {"holiday":"Good Friday","date":"2023-04-07","observed":"2023-04-07"},
  {"holiday":"Victoria Day","date":"2023-05-22","observed":"2023-05-22"},
  {"holiday":"Canada Day","date":"2023-07-01","observed":"2023-07-03"},
  {"holiday":"Labour Day","date":"2023-09-04","observed":"2023-09-04"},
  {"holiday":"Thanksgiving","date":"2023-10-09","observed":"2023-10-09"},
  {"holiday":"Remembrance Day","date":"2023-11-11","observed":"2023-11-13"},
  {"holiday":"Christmas","date":"2023-12-25","observed":"2023-12-25"}
]
```

> **Pro tip:** If your app needs province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, etc.), you’ll need to pull the relevant provincial calendars. The above list covers the federal holidays that generate long weekends across the entire country.

Feel free to copy the table or JSON into your holiday‑planning app. Let me know if you’d like additional details (e.g., province‑specific long weekends, or a different format).
